recognize_zh: 10 倍下濾泡中央是一個很小、粉紅玻璃樣變的萎縮生發中心，內含少數核大淡染的濾泡樹突細胞與內皮細胞，外圍小淋巴球層層同心排列成明顯的洋蔥皮狀外套區，濾泡間有增生的血管；典型的透明血管型 Castleman 病濾泡。
features: Small central regressed germinal center with hyalinized eosinophilic stroma
Germinal center contains a few follicular dendritic cells with enlarged vesicular nuclei and plump endothelial cells
Strikingly concentric onion-skin layering of small mature mantle lymphocytes
Interfollicular areas with increased small vessels lined by plump endothelial cells
Absence of tingible-body macrophages and atypical large cells
describe_en: Lymph node section at intermediate power shows a follicle with a small, hyalinized, lymphocyte-depleted germinal center containing a few follicular dendritic cells with enlarged vesicular nuclei and endothelial cells. The germinal center is encircled by an expanded mantle zone of small mature lymphocytes arranged in concentric onion-skin layers. The interfollicular stroma is highly vascular with plump endothelial cells. Findings are consistent with a regressed germinal center with dysplastic follicular dendritic cells in unicentric hyaline-vascular Castleman disease.

ddx.dx: Mantle cell lymphoma, mantle zone pattern
ddx.vs: MCL mantles consist of monotonous slightly irregular cyclin D1+/CD5+ cells, whereas these mantle lymphocytes are polyclonal and the germinal center is hyalinized.
iMCD usually has sheet-like interfollicular plasmacytosis and systemic inflammatory features with multiple enlarged node stations, rather than a solitary hyaline-vascular lesion.
Reactive follicles show large active germinal centers with centroblasts, mitoses and tingible-body macrophages and a thin polarized mantle.
